newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mexican ex-president escapes blazing French hotel.
newsitem.headline: Mexican ex-president escapes blazing French hotel.

text.p: Former Mexican president Miguel de la Madrid escaped unhurt from a blaze which devastated a hotel in the southern French town of Toulouse during the night, officials said on Friday.
Radio reports said de la Madrid, Mexico's president from 1982-88, raised the alarm after waking up in the middle of the night to see his curtains on fire at the Hotel de l'Opera.
A spokesman for the prefect, the area's government representative, said de la Madrid was not injured.
Four people were overcome by fumes and treated in hospital, and a fireman was slightly injured. The blaze destroyed at least 10 rooms at the hotel.
